newsitem.title: UK: NWE gas oil eases as futures head lower.
newsitem.headline: NWE gas oil eases as futures head lower.

text.p: NWE gas oil prices eased slightly lower on Wednesday as underlying futures sagged.

Benchmark IPE June futures shed $1.50 a tonne to close at $176.50 with losses attributed to mildly bearish API data released late on Tuesday showing U.S. middle distillates stocks rose by 1.9 million barrels last week.
Premiums were little changed, with heating oil barges trading at June IPE +$2.50 fob Rotterdam and +$1.50 fob Flushing.
A barge for early June delivery traded at June IPE +$1.50 a tonne fob Rotterdam.
A diesel barge traded at June IPE +$10 fob Rotterdam, while demand for EN590 cargoes was seen strong.
Russian heating oil cargoes were expected to come under pressure with supply plentiful. Cargoes were offered at $7 below quotations and may slip another $1, traders said.
